title: File Handling — Reading from a CSV file

files.main.py:
firstNames = []
surnames = []
scores = []
grades = []

with open("marks.csv", "r") as file:
    next(file)  # Skip the header row
    for line in file:
        data = line.strip().split(",")
        firstNames.append(data[0])
        surnames.append(data[1])
        scores.append(int(data[2]))
        grades.append(data[3])

print("Student Results")
print("-" * 40)
for i in range(len(firstNames)):
    print(firstNames[i], surnames[i], "-", scores[i], "(", grades[i], ")")

# Calculate class average
total = 0
for score in scores:
    total += score
average = total / len(scores)

print("-" * 40)
print("Class average:", round(average, 1))
